# Long stanza test: stanza 2 is taller than a page

1
[D]Walking down the [G]long road [D]home,
The [Bm]evening sky is [A]wide and [D]still;
[D]Every step a [G]quiet [D]psalm,
The [G]lantern [A]burning on the [D]hill.

2
[D]By the river we [G]walk along, line 1
[Bm]By the meadow we [A]walk along, line 2
[G]By the harbour we [D]walk along, line 3
[Em]By the valley we [A7]walk along, line 4
[D]By the mountain we [G]walk along, line 5
[Bm]By the orchard we [A]walk along, line 6
[G]By the village we [D]walk along, line 7
[Em]By the morning we [A7]walk along, line 8
[D]By the river we [G]walk along, line 9
[Bm]By the meadow we [A]walk along, line 10
[G]This line is deliberately long so that it has to wrap onto a second row on the page, with the [D]chord moving together with its syllable
[Em]By the valley we [A7]walk along, line 12
[D]By the mountain we [G]walk along, line 13
[Bm]By the orchard we [A]walk along, line 14
[G]By the village we [D]walk along, line 15
[Em]By the morning we [A7]walk along, line 16
[D]By the river we [G]walk along, line 17
[Bm]By the meadow we [A]walk along, line 18
[G]By the harbour we [D]walk along, line 19
[Em]By the valley we [A7]walk along, line 20
Past the **mountain** and the *quiet* [D]stream, [G]line 21
[Bm]By the orchard we [A]walk along, line 22
[G]By the village we [D]walk along, line 23
[Em]By the morning we [A7]walk along, line 24
[D]By the river we [G]walk along, line 25
[Bm]By the meadow we [A]walk along, line 26
[G]By the harbour we [D]walk along, line 27
[Em]By the valley we [A7]walk along, line 28
[D]By the mountain we [G]walk along, line 29
[Bm]By the orchard we [A]walk along, line 30
[G]By the village we [D]walk along, line 31
[Em]By the morning we [A7]walk along, line 32
[D]By the river we [G]walk along, line 33
[Bm]By the meadow we [A]walk along, line 34
[G]By the harbour we [D]walk along, line 35
[Em]By the valley we [A7]walk along, line 36
[D]By the mountain we [G]walk along, line 37
[Bm]By the orchard we [A]walk along, line 38
[G]By the village we [D]walk along, line 39
[Em]By the morning we [A7]walk along, line 40

[Bm]By the meadow we [A]walk along, line 42
[G]By the harbour we [D]walk along, line 43
[Em]By the valley we [A7]walk along, line 44

  [G]Home, [D]home, the [A]long road [D]home,
  [G]Carry me [A]on to [D]home.

3
[D]When the journey's [G]done at [D]last,
[Bm]All the [A]miles are [D]past.
